title: The termwise scalar extension unit identifies with the derived unit
statement: For every cochain complex C of integral coefficient modules on X, there is an isomorphism from the image under Q of termwise restricted scalar extension of C to restriction of the specified left derived scalar extension of Q(C). Under this isomorphism Q of the termwise extension unit equals the specified mixed derived adjunction unit. Definitions and notation: [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-scalar-exact].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Exactness of integral scalar extension supplies the exact levelwise derived adjunction. Use its existing unit factorization on a homotopy-category object. On the image of C, the homotopy adjunction unit is the quotient image of the complex adjunction unit. The natural isomorphism quotient⋙Qh≅Q transports the unit equation to Q(C). The left adjoints of the exact and mixed derived adjunctions to the same exact restriction are uniquely isomorphic, compatibly with units. Compose these isomorphisms to obtain the stated comparison.

proof_origin.note: B2: explicit scalar telescope construction and categorical compatibility. This auxiliary declaration is proved in the delivery, not a new assumption.

theorem integralScalar_derivedUnit_complex (X : Scheme.{u})
    (C : CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ℤ) :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
              (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((Mod.extendScalars
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)) ≅
        ((Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapDerivedCategory).obj
          ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).unit.app C) ≫ e.hom =
        (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction
          (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
